headline: Systemd unit no longer reports `failure` on graceful SIGTERM
summary: `deploy/hermitstash-sync.service` now whitelists exit code 143 as a successful shutdown so `systemctl stop hermitstash-sync` reports `inactive (dead)` instead of `failed`. Behaviour of the daemon itself is unchanged.

items.title: `systemctl stop hermitstash-sync` reports `inactive (dead)` on a clean SIGTERM
items.body: The SEA-embedded Node runtime exits with status 143 when the signal handler completes and `process.exit(0)` runs; `tini` (Docker entrypoint) translates it consistently, but the unsupervised systemd unit treated 143 as an abnormal exit. The unit now carries `SuccessExitStatus=143` so a graceful shutdown reaches the dead-active state instead of dead-failed.
